extracted.name: Mustard Sauce for Ham
extracted.description: This sweet mustard sauce is fabulous! Easy enough for any night of the week. GREAT on baked ham or even chicken strips.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, mix together the flour, sugar and mustard powder until evenly blended. Whisk together the milk and egg yolks in a saucepan, and slowly whisk in the mustard mixture. Stir in the vinegar. Whisking constantly, bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, reduce heat to low, and simmer until thickened.
